sections.text: Just Wait for Me, Yuna and Everyone

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 280. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 280-Ability-Power attack that deals physical water damage to all enemies 5 times at success of 100 by 200.
Only [Belief] Mimori Togo can be used as Unlocking Potential material
